pretransfer_abi_screen.reader: Cached Ubuntu ARM64 image supplies GNU readelf only; no network, input mount read-only; candidate ELF is never executed.
pretransfer_abi_screen.target_baseline: target_abi_baseline embedded in this audit; exact provider definitions, captured file hashes, libc/libstdc++ hashes verified against archived build-evidence/target-toolchain.json
pretransfer_abi_screen.source_review: Independent subagent identified truncated readelf output could otherwise appear empty; fixed with declared provider/Name counts and refusal of exit-zero reader diagnostics, covered by regressions.
pretransfer_abi_screen.scope_limit: Checks architecture and direct GLIBC/GLIBCXX/CXXABI version-definition membership. Does not prove dependency closure, individual symbol implementations, ROS ABI or target loadability. Retain target ldd/runtime gate. Sectionless ELF and extended section numbering are explicitly refused rather than interpreting empty version output as compatibility.
pretransfer_abi_screen.packaging_integration: Manual pre-transfer command ready; not automatically wired into packaging yet.

sectionless_regression.finding: GNU readelf --version-info exits0 with No version information found for the real v1 controller after only e_shoff/e_shnum/e_shstrndx are cleared; loader-visible program headers and dynamic payload remain unchanged.
